vb_textbox.text: My advice to you is to memorise in your head the colour combination of the gnomes fetching the most mushrooms from the pairings. I believe that with each selection, each of the gnomes in the pairing is either going up or down between1-9 and you start to pick up on when that colour gnome is starting to go down towards zero and that is when you start selecting the other gnome in that parent. A gnome who is getting you 9 mushrooms is never going to drop down to 0 with 1 click, they will go down gradually so you can pick up on when it is the right time to change the colour of the gnome you are selecting.If you follow this then you should be regularly picking 5-9 mushrooms with every single selection and this will give you the best chance of having a high score.
